title: 在大脚点上换脚
description: 成人在宽大脚点上缓慢换脚，双手与另一支点稳定。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult slowly replaces one foot with the other on an extra-wide low foothold, with both shoes briefly close together. Both hands stay on large jugs and the torso remains stable near the wall; no hopping or airborne swap occurs. Show the movement from a low diagonal angle that keeps the shoe positions distinct. A broad neighboring step-down hold and empty mat make the controlled transition feel deliberately accessible. Use colored-pencil illustration with visible directional marks, soft graphite structure, and a quiet sage, blue, and brick palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
